## Diverging Signals
- **Dow and small caps up, Nasdaq flat.** DJI +1.08% and Russell 2000 +1.38% against NDX −0.05% (2026-10-15). Money is moving out of tech into the rest of the market. That fits the AI-led weakness noted last read, but it is not a broad sell-off.
- **Calm VIX, rich tail protection.** VIX is 16.13 and the VIX/VIX3M ratio is 0.890 (contango), but SKEW is 160.45 and MOVE is 102.49. Headline fear is low while crash cover is priced high. Sellers of puts are paid for tail risk even though the surface looks calm.
- **Falling 10Y, rising HY OAS.** The 10Y eased to 5.089% while HY OAS widened to 3.25%. Lower rates are normally a relief. Wider junk spreads say credit is not fully joining it.
- **TQQQ options look rich against actual movement.** ATM IV is 0.59 (59%) and IV/HV (20d) is 1.22, with HV20 at 48.7%. Options cost about 22% more than recent actual movement, which is a modest cushion. It is below the crude 3x-VXN estimate of about 69%.

## TQQQ Read
- **Momentum:** RSI(14) is 37.0, neutral but heading toward oversold (40.3 two reads ago). It is not below 30 yet. After four red sessions in a row, the slide is closer to a stretch, so a mean-reversion bounce is more plausible than at the last read, but there is no confirmation of one.
- **Market structure:** SIDEWAYS. Spot is 13.5% below the 4-week high ($85.32) and 5.5% above the 4-week low ($69.99). RALLY needs more than 30% above the low (above about $90.99), which is 23.3% away. DOWNTURN needs more than 20% below the high (below about $68.26, −7.5%) AND VXN of 25 or more. VXN is 22.89, so neither holds.
- **Trend:** Mixed. Spot is 1.06% under the 50DMA ($74.61) and about 14.4% above the 200DMA. The longer uptrend backdrop holds, but the medium-term line is lost, and it is 15.84% under the 52-week high.
- **Volatility & premium environment:** VXN is 22.89. Measured ATM IV is 59% (2026-10-15T20:45Z) against 20-day realised movement (HV20) of 48.7%, so IV/HV is 1.22: options cost about 22% more than the stock has recently moved, a modest cushion for sellers. SKEW at 160.45 means downside protection is priced high. Swing risk is high: TQQQ moves about 3 times the Nasdaq-100.
- **Put-selling context: CAUTIOUS.** TQQQ is below its 50DMA, has four red sessions in a row and sits 5.5% above its 4-week low. Premium carries a modest cushion over realised movement (IV/HV 1.22), and credit is still calm, VIX is 16.13, and the VIX term structure is in contango. It is not hostile yet. The FOMC decision on Oct 28 is 12 days out, and the market-implied odds (66% on no hike, per the news feed) are not a settled outcome. The line to watch is VXN at 25 with TQQQ under about $68.26, which would flip the structure to DOWNTURN.
